login.title: Sign in

login.failed: Sign-in failed, please check your credentials
login.codeHint: Send /login to the bot in a KOOK direct message to get a 6-digit code valid for 5 minutes.
login.bindHint: After signing in, enter a /bind code here to link your KOOK identity to this account.
login.dryRunNotice: Offline demo mode (KOOK_DRYRUN=1): the bot is not connected to KOOK.
login.securityNotice: Failed attempts are rate-limited and audited; KOOK users without a role mapping cannot sign in.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.subtitle: You must change the initial password before using the console
changePassword.forced: For account security, please change the initial password first.
changePassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match
changePassword.success: Password updated; sessions on other devices were revoked
changePassword.hint: At least 12 characters, including two of: uppercase, lowercase, digits, symbols.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Overall ticket throughput and recent trends

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.description: Filter by status, keyword and date range; the keyword matches number, nickname and message content

ticket.timelineEmpty: No messages archived for this ticket yet
ticket.timelineHint: Messages are archived from the KOOK channel in real time; this view is read-only
ticket.notesPlaceholder: Write a resolution or handover note (internal only)
ticket.closeDialogDesc: The KOOK channel will be deleted and a notification sent to the requester and log channel. This cannot be undone.
ticket.closeNoteLabel: Closing note (optional, included in the notification)
ticket.lockDialogDesc: The requester can still read the channel but cannot send messages; admins are unaffected.
ticket.reopenDialogDesc: The requester regains permission to send messages in the ticket channel.

panels.title: Ticket panels
panels.description: Multiple button cards per channel; each card has its own text, panel admin roles, and the message the bot posts after a ticket opens. Card text supports multi-line KMarkdown
panels.note: Creating or rebuilding panels requires the bot to be online (next milestone). Currently shows stored configuration only.
panels.createDesc: The bot posts a button card in the selected channel; members click it to open a ticket. You can add multiple cards to the same channel, with multi-line KMarkdown text.
panels.channelPlaceholder: Select or type a channel ID
panels.openMessagePlaceholder:
To help us resolve this faster, please provide:
1. Order number or screenshot
2. When the issue started
panels.openMessageHint: After a ticket is opened, the bot posts this message separately in the ticket channel; leave empty to skip it. Variables: {user} mention, {user_name}, {ticket_no}, {time}. The text is rendered as KMarkdown, and `# heading`, `__underline__` and `- list` are converted to KOOK-compatible syntax before sending.
panels.deleteDesc: The panel configuration is removed and the card message is deleted when possible. Existing tickets are unaffected.
panels.rolesDesc: These roles are mentioned on new tickets and can handle tickets from this panel
panels.botOffline: The bot is not connected to KOOK: creating panels requires it online (button signatures are produced by the bot). Configure and reconnect in Settings first.
panels.needChannel: Please select or type a channel ID
panels.titleHint: KMarkdown supported: **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, `inline code`, ```code block```, > quote, [link](https://example.com), and (met)userID(met) mentions. For KOOK compatibility, a leading `# heading` becomes the card title, `__underline__` is converted to KOOK's (ins)underline(ins), and `- list` items become "• item" bullets. (KOOK's KMarkdown itself supports none of # heading, __underline__ or - list, so the server converts them before sending.)
panels.previewEmpty: Type text on the left to see the preview here
panels.editDesc: Card text and the open message both support KMarkdown and multiple lines. When card text or the button label changes and the bot is online, the channel card is rebuilt; changing only the open message applies on save without rebuilding the card (it affects tickets opened afterwards only).
panels.editSaved: Text saved. Rebuild the card once the bot is online to apply it.
panels.openMessageSaved: Open message saved; it applies only to tickets opened afterwards.

emoji.title: Reaction roles
emoji.description: When a user reacts to the configured message, the bot grants the mapped role
emoji.note: Editing rules arrives in a later milestone; current rules come from DryRun demo data.
emoji.createDesc: Post a role-selection message in a channel (the KOOK card editor works), then register the message ID and the emoji→role mapping here.
emoji.messageHint: Right-click the message in KOOK → copy message ID (enable developer mode first)
emoji.emojiHint: Select an emoji in the KOOK client and press Ctrl+C to copy it; for custom emojis check emoji.id in the bot logs
emoji.deleteDesc: The emoji will no longer grant a role; already granted roles are kept.

users.title: Accounts
users.description: WebUI accounts come in three roles; KOOK-linked accounts inherit permissions from the role mapping
users.createSuccess: Account created; password change required on first sign-in
users.editDisabledHint: All sessions of this account are revoked immediately
users.resetDesc: All sessions of this account are revoked; a password change is required at next sign-in.
users.deleteDesc: This cannot be undone and all sessions are removed immediately.
users.selfEditBlocked: You cannot modify or disable your own account
users.lastAdmin: At least one active administrator must remain

roles.title: Roles & access
roles.description: Global admin roles decide who can handle tickets; role mappings decide WebUI permissions after KOOK sign-in
roles.adminDesc: Members with these KOOK roles can handle, close and annotate tickets
roles.mappingDesc: When multiple rules match, the highest permission wins; users matching nothing cannot sign in

bot.title: Bot status
bot.description: Connection state, runtime info and configuration overview
bot.dryRunHint: KOOK is not connected: ticket actions only update the database and UI, no channels or messages are created.
bot.missingDesc: The bot cannot handle real tickets until these are configured:
bot.noBot: The bot module is not enabled

activity.title: Bot activity
activity.description: Manage the game library and set what the bot is playing or listening to
activity.offlineDesc: The game library and activity controls need a live KOOK connection. Configure and reconnect under Settings first.
activity.dryRunDesc: Offline demo mode: activity changes are not sent to KOOK and only affect the UI.
activity.currentDesc: What the bot is playing or listening to; KOOK may take a moment to sync
activity.stopDesc: This clears the bot's playing/listening state on KOOK and disables restoring it after reconnect.
activity.readonlyHint: Read-only accounts cannot change the activity
activity.startDesc: Pick a game or fill in the track info to set the bot's activity
activity.selectGamePlaceholder: Choose a game from the library
activity.noGames: The game library is empty — create a game first
activity.startGameSuccess: The bot is now playing the game
activity.autoRestoreHint: KOOK clears the activity when the bot goes offline; enable this to restore it automatically on reconnect
activity.libraryDesc: Backed by KOOK's game API; at most 5 games per day, and only user-created games can be edited or deleted
activity.createDesc: The game can be used for the bot activity right away; KOOK allows at most 5 new games per day
activity.deleteDesc: The game will be removed from the library. This cannot be undone; an activity already using it is unaffected.
activity.iconHint: An http(s) image URL; leave empty to use the KOOK default
activity.needOnline: The bot must be connected to KOOK

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Bot token and channel configuration; the token is write-only and shown masked
settings.tokenHint: Leave empty to keep the current token. Tokens are stored AES-GCM encrypted and never returned in plaintext.
settings.categoryHint: Ticket channels are created inside this category; a hidden category is recommended.
settings.outdateHint: Tickets without messages for this long are locked automatically; 0 disables it.
settings.idInvalid: Must be a numeric KOOK ID
settings.missingNone: All required settings are in place 🎉
